policy: Commit the sealed reports and evidence byte-for-byte, including explicitly selected ignored outputs. Keep two downloaded CLI payloads and one credential-bearing runtime log local; publish a separate redacted log copy. The original sealed local package is unchanged.

omitted_downloaded_artifacts.reason: Downloaded third-party CLI artifact; retained locally and hash-bound in the original delivery manifest.

steps: Verify its SHA-512 against antigravity-release-manifest.json and SHA-256 against DELIVERY-MANIFEST.json.
Extract the agy executable to provider-route-repair/bin/agy and verify its SHA-256 against DELIVERY-MANIFEST.json.

The complete original package verifier additionally requires the original private runtime log from its custodian; a public checkout intentionally omits it. Do not insert the redacted copy into the sealed package path.

omitted_sensitive_artifacts.reason: Contains a local executor-viewer access token. Original retained locally; never published.

credential_review.disposition: Reviewed hash manifests, public contract/test identifiers, fixture addresses and public GPG fingerprints as non-credentials. One local viewer-token log is omitted; a separate redacted copy is published.
